title: U.S. Regulator Allows Banks to Hold Crypto for Blockchain Fees
summary: Bitcoin MagazineU.S. Regulator Allows Banks to Hold Crypto for Blockchain FeesThe OCC has clarified that U.S. national banks may hold crypto on their balance sheets to pay blockchain network fees and test crypto platforms.This postU.S. Regulator Allows Banks to Hold Crypto for Blockchain Feesfirst appeared onBitcoin Magazineand is written byMicah Zimmerman.

title: Treasury Dept. Says Banks Can Keep Crypto On Their Balance Sheets in Certain Cases
summary: National banks can now officially hold crypto to pay for network gas fees and engage in other crypto-related experiments, the OCC said Tuesday.
